pairs: The heavens describe the glory of God,
et opera manuum ejus annuntiat firmamentum.
and the firmament announces the work of his hands.
Day proclaims the word to day,
and night to night imparts knowledge.
where their voices are not being heard.
In omnem terram exivit sonus eorum,
Their sound has gone forth through all the earth,
et in fines orbis terræ verba eorum.
and their words to the ends of the world.
He has placed his tabernacle in the sun,
et ipse tamquam sponsus procedens de thalamo suo.
and he is like a bridegroom coming out of his bedroom.
Exsultavit ut gigas ad currendam viam;
He has exulted like a giant running along the way;
his departure is from the summit of heaven.
Et occursus ejus usque ad summum ejus;
And his course reaches all the way to its summit.
nec est qui se abscondat a calore ejus.
Neither is there anyone who can hide himself from his heat.
The law of the Lord is immaculate,
The testimony of the Lord is faithful,
The justice of the Lord is right,
The precepts of the Lord are brilliant,
The fear of the Lord is holy,
The judgments of the Lord are true,
desiderabilia super aurum et lapidem pretiosum multum,
desirable beyond gold and many precious stones,
et dulciora super mel et favum.
and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.
For, indeed, your servant keeps them,
and in keeping them, there are many rewards.
From my hidden faults, cleanse me, O Lord,
et ab alienis parce servo tuo.
and from those of others, spare your servant.
If they will have no dominion over me,
and I will be cleansed from the greatest transgression.
Et erunt ut complaceant eloquia oris mei,
And the eloquence of my mouth will be so as to please,
et meditatio cordis mei in conspectu tuo semper.
along with the meditation of my heart, in your sight,
O Lord, my helper and my redeemer.
